title: 第159章 焦急的马教父
slug: 穿越民国获得每日签到系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

马神父站在原地，冷汗已经湿透了后背。

他闭上眼睛，在胸前飞快地画了一个十字，随后脱力般地靠在紧闭的铁门上，大口大口地喘着粗气。

但他没有崩溃。

他脑子里飞快地盘算着原田直人那句“把难民一个个抓进宪兵队审问”。

粮食没了还能再想办法，可如果惹恼了日本人，这几百个老弱病残全得进大牢！

他深吸了一口气，强行压下心头的惊惧，将颤抖的双手背在身后。

他匆匆交代了旁边的助手几句，便披上那件洗得发白的外套。

迈开步子，头也不回地走出了教堂。

他凭着之前交接粮食时留下的模糊地址。

在法租界边缘的几条巷子里挨家挨户地打听“姓顾的东家”。

可换来的全是一头雾水和摇头。

天色渐渐暗了下来，冷风像刀子一样刮在脸上。

马神父站在陌生的巷口，望着灰蒙蒙的街道，眉头死死地拧在一起。

他不知道顾东家到底有什么通天的本事。但他知道，如果明天天亮前顾东家不露面。

这满院子的难民，还有他这个神父，恐怕都要大难临头。

就在马神父咬紧牙关，准备硬着头皮继续往前找时。

街角转出来一个穿着粗布棉袄、头上包着褪色头巾的妇人。

她手里挎着一个竹篮，里面装着几把青菜。

看起来就像是刚下工，正准备赶着去菜市场买晚饭的普通女佣。

那妇人走到马神父面前，突然停下了脚步。

上下打量了他一眼，眼中闪过一丝恰到好处的惊讶。

“哎，马神父？你怎么在这里？”

妇人压低了嗓音，用只有他们两个人能听见的声音说道。

马神父猛地抬起头，死死盯着眼前这张毫无印象的脸。

可当他对上那双熟悉的眼睛时，他浑身一震，眼底瞬间迸发出一抹亮光。

他立刻上前一步，压低声音。

语气急促却极力克制着：“是……是顾东家派来的那位管事大姐？！”

叶静姝不动声色地环顾了一下四周，确认没有宪兵队的暗哨，才微微颔首。

她下了班之后特意换了这身伪装，本来就是准备去教堂找马神父的。

谁知道刚走到这条巷子，就碰见了从教堂里出来，满脸焦急找她的马神父。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Father Ma stood there, his back soaked with cold sweat.

He closed his eyes, quickly crossed himself on his chest, and then leaned against the closed iron door as if helpless, breathing heavily.

But he didn't collapse.

He was rapidly thinking about Harada Naoto's words of "arrest the refugees one by one into the military police for interrogation."

If the food is gone, you can still think of something else, but if you offend the Japanese, these hundreds of old, weak, sick and disabled people will all go to jail!

He took a deep breath, suppressed the fear in his heart, and put his trembling hands behind his back.

He hurriedly told the assistant next to him a few words, and then put on the washed white coat.

He took a step forward and walked out of the church without looking back.

He relied on the vague address he left when delivering the food.

I went from house to house in the alleys on the edge of the French Concession and asked about "the owner named Gu".

All he got in return was confusion and shaking of his head.

The sky was getting dark, and the cold wind was blowing on my face like a knife.

Father Ma stood at the entrance of an unfamiliar alley, looking at the gray street, his brows knitted together.

He didn't know what extraordinary abilities Gu Dongjia had.But he knew that if Gu Dongjia didn't show up before dawn tomorrow.

This courtyard full of refugees, as well as him, the priest, might be in trouble.

Just when Father Ma gritted his teeth and was about to bite the bullet and continue looking.

Turning the corner, a woman wearing a coarse cotton-padded jacket and a faded headscarf on her head came out.

She was carrying a bamboo basket in her hand, which contained several handfuls of vegetables.

She looked like an ordinary maid who had just finished work and was rushing to the market to buy dinner.

The woman walked up to Father Ma and suddenly stopped.

He looked him up and down, with a hint of just the right amount of surprise in his eyes.

"Hey, Father Ma? Why are you here?"

The woman lowered her voice and spoke in a voice that only the two of them could hear.

Father Ma suddenly raised his head and stared at the unimpressive face in front of him.

But when he met those familiar eyes, he was shocked, and a flash of light suddenly burst out from his eyes.

He immediately took a step forward and lowered his voice.

His tone was urgent but he tried his best to control it: "Is...is it the stewardess sent by Gu Dong's family?!"

Ye Jingshu looked around calmly, confirming that there was no hidden whistle from the gendarmerie, and then nodded slightly.

She specially changed her disguise after getting off work, originally planning to go to the church to find Father Ma.

Unexpectedly, as soon as she walked into this alley, she met Father Ma who came out of the church and looked for her anxiously.
